title: Amintaccen da aka ba wa Kogin
intro: Wata rai ta fuskanci wani hukunci mai wuya, inda rayuwar jariri ta tsaya cak. Da wahayi daga Allah ya jagorance ta, an bi umarnin da ba a so, kuma an sanya wani sirri mai tamani a kan ruwan, sai kawai aka dawo da shi ta hanyar da ba a zata ba.
clues: Na zauna a ƙarƙashin inuwar wani azzalumin da ya ba da umarnin kashe jarirai maza.
Wata wahayi daga Allah ta zo mini, tana umurtata da in ɗauki wani mataki mai cike da damuwa da kuma ɓacin rai.
Na sanya jaririyata mai daraja a cikin akwati na ajiye shi a kan kogin da ke gudana.
Zuciyata ta yi fanko, kuma kusan na bayyana sirrin, amma Allah ya ƙarfafa ni.
Na aika wani ya biyo tafiyar yaron zuwa ƙasa yayin da wutar lantarki ta ɗauke akwatin.
Gidan azzalumi ne ya sami yaron, kuma daga ƙarshe, na sake haɗuwa da ɗana na zama mai kula da yara.

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
